title: What's New: Sales Lines Suggestions with Copilot (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Improved Product Search and Context Understanding

features.name: Improved keyword extraction for product search
features.description: Copilot now better extracts keywords from natural language queries, recognizing compound words even without spaces between them. For example, 'guestchairs' is correctly understood as 'guest chairs'.

features.name: Context understanding for product queries
features.description: Copilot understands context in product queries, distinguishing between similar items based on modifiers like 'small', 'bigger', or 'commercial use' to suggest the appropriate product variant.

features.name: 10x faster product search
features.description: Product search performance has improved up to 10 times faster. For a database with 40,000 items, search time decreased from 60 seconds to approximately 6 seconds.

features.name: Blanket order search and linking
features.description: Users can now search for items from blanket orders as source documents. The feature establishes a direct link to the blanket order line, preventing quantities from exceeding what is available in the blanket order.
caveats: only prevents exceeding linked blanket order quantities

features.name: Document-specific item search
features.description: Users can narrow product search to specific documents by specifying a document number or ID, limiting search results to items already included in that document rather than the entire item list.

features.name: Units of measure support
features.description: Sales line suggestions now support all configured units of measure for items, including pieces, bottles, kilos, pallets, bags, packs, and other custom units.

features.name: CSV file support for sales line suggestions
features.description: Users can now upload CSV files to generate sales line suggestions with structured data. The feature analyzes the CSV, extracts column information including product, quantity, and unit of measure, and allows users to map columns before generating suggestions.
caveats: currently only supports CSV file type

features.name: CSV column mapping and detection
features.description: Copilot automatically detects CSV structure including column separator (tab, comma, etc.) and maps columns to product information, quantity, and unit of measure. Users can review and modify mappings before generating suggestions.

features.name: CSV mapping caching
features.description: When a user confirms CSV suggestions, the column mappings are cached and saved. If a similar CSV with the same header structure is uploaded in the future, the cached mapping is automatically applied, eliminating the need to re-analyze the CSV.
